io.name: areset
io.description: Asynchronous positive-edge reset; clears history register to zero.

io.name: predict_valid
io.description: Indicates a branch prediction is being made; shift predict_taken into history.

io.name: predict_taken
io.description: Predicted direction of the youngest branch; shifted into LSB of history.

io.name: train_mispredicted
io.description: Indicates a branch misprediction; load history from train_history concatenated with train_taken.

io.name: train_taken
io.description: Actual direction of the mispredicted branch; becomes new LSB of history.

io.name: train_history
io.description: History before the mispredicted branch; upper 32 bits of the restored history.

io.name: predict_history
io.description: Current branch history register value; bit 0 is the youngest branch direction.

functional_summary.overview: 32-bit global branch history shift register with prediction shifting and misprediction rollback. Asynchronously reset to zero. On each posedge clk, if train_mispredicted is asserted, load history with {train_history, train_taken} (misprediction takes precedence over prediction). Otherwise, if predict_valid is asserted, shift history left by one and insert predict_taken at LSB.
rules: areset asserted asynchronously clears predict_history to 0.
On posedge clk with train_mispredicted=1: predict_history <= {train_history[31:0], train_taken} (train_taken becomes bit 0).
On posedge clk with train_mispredicted=0 and predict_valid=1: predict_history <= {predict_history[30:0], predict_taken}.
On posedge clk with train_mispredicted=0 and predict_valid=0: predict_history holds its value.
If both train_mispredicted and predict_valid are asserted, misprediction takes precedence and prediction is ignored.
predict_history[0] represents the direction of the youngest branch.
